name: FullJFETModels
_comment_tr: JFET kucuk-sinyal sablonu - Full seviye (Analog Insydes FullJFETSmallSignal, simp==0). Simplified'a ek olarak seri ohmik drain/source dirençleri: R_d (D ile ic dugum DS arasi), R_s (S ile ic dugum SS arasi). Kucuk-sinyal cekirdegi (C_gd, C_gs, R_ds, G_m) ic dugumlere baglanir; RD/RS != 0 ise DS/SS gercek dugum olur, yoksa dejenerasyon temizleme onlari kisaltip modeli Simplified'e indirir. Gecit sizinti direncleri R_gd/R_gs guvenlik icin D/S PORTLARINA baglanir (cozulmezse dugum birlestirmeden dusurulsun diye). RD/RS .out'un JFET MODEL PARAMETERS tablosundan, deger cozumu netlist/Model.py._jfet_ac_param_values (RD/AREA, RS/AREA).
_comment_en: JFET small-signal template - Full level (Analog Insydes FullJFETSmallSignal, simp==0). Simplified plus the series ohmic drain/source resistors: R_d (between D and the internal node DS), R_s (between S and the internal node SS). The small-signal core (C_gd, C_gs, R_ds, G_m) attaches to the internal nodes; when RD/RS != 0 the DS/SS nodes materialise, otherwise the degeneracy cleanup shorts them and the model collapses to Simplified. The gate leak resistors R_gd/R_gs attach to the D/S PORTS (so an unresolved leak is dropped rather than merging nodes). RD/RS come from the .out JFET MODEL PARAMETERS table; value resolution in netlist/Model.py._jfet_ac_param_values (RD/AREA, RS/AREA).
